name: heavy-howitzer
_doc: heavy field howitzer (곡사포): large 15 cm class piece, no shield, box trail, big spoked wheels, 4 crew (gunner, loader, trail man, ammo man). Deployed = crew-served gun. Travel (move_1..4) = horse-drawn: limber hitched to the trail, 2 draught horses, 2 men seated on the limber (driver + 1), 2 walking beside. Frame 976x656, anchor = ground under the GUN footprint centre in EVERY cell (deploy / march / unhitch frames do not jump); the horse team extends forward.
